_about: How to read smashline_* names found in a moveset's plugin.nro. The full name lists per release are in smashline_<version>_names.txt. Add a release: drop its names file next to them and add it to 'releases' (oldest first).
abiNote: Smashline 2.0.0 changed the argument layout of these functions without renaming them. Old ABI: clone_weapon(name ptr x0, len x1, kind w2, str x3/x4, str x5/x6, bool w7). New ABI: clone_weapon(str x0/x1, str x2/x3, kind w4, bool w5).
